entries.scene_prompt: Modern community planning meeting begins. Speaker immediately points directly to one clear central problem: a broken footbridge shown in a large picture on table, while facing listeners with an open speaking mouth and concise focused gesture. Beside problem picture lie actual loose broken bridge planks as evidence. Other unrelated decorative meeting materials, refreshments and scenic pictures remain closed or set aside untouched. Three listeners promptly turn attention to damaged bridge image, one holds simple repair materials. No long introduction, no irrelevant talk, straight to the concrete issue. A single straight graphite line from speaker's finger to break in picture can emphasize direct focus, no text labels arrows letters or numbers. Natural anatomy two arms five fingers, table and objects grounded. Landscape 3:2 graphite watercolor colored pencil ivory paper, no brands logos watermarks.
entries.alt: 會議一開始，發言者立刻指向破損人行橋的照片說明問題，其他裝飾資料仍擱在一旁，大家直接專注在修橋上。

entries.scene_prompt: Modern neighborhood birthday gathering. A normally plainly dressed adult guest humorously joins a brief make-believe game just to match cheerful occasion: he loosely wears a crooked cardboard crown and holds a cardboard spoon as pretend royal scepter, playfully bows to children wearing simple animal paper masks. Everyone laughs, casual ordinary party setting with borrowed props from an open costume box, no real theater stage or serious audience. A small soft-edged next-moment inset shows same guest has set crown and spoon back in box and cheerfully returns to helping carry plates in regular clothes, making clear temporary playful participation rather than a real title or profession. entries.scene_prompt: Modern community gardening workshop. A young presenter explains composting in a very clear logical sequence, speaking calmly and pointing to four large picture-only cards arranged LEFT TO RIGHT: sort vegetable scraps, layer with dry leaves, turn mixture with small fork, use rich finished compost for seedling. Under each card on the table is the corresponding real material or demonstration tray, aligned exactly so listeners can easily follow the reasoning step by step. Three listeners nod with understanding, one compares same four pictures in a booklet with no writing. Emphasize organized coherent explanation rather than merely tidy objects or fast speech. Correct organic materials and compost stages, grounded trays, presenter two arms, natural five fingers, hand pointer contact, stable table perspective. entries.scene_prompt: Modern child saving a single small plain coin regularly. Three connected soft-edged time scenes from left to right show SAME child and SAME transparent jar: first just a few coins, then half-full after repeated tiny deposits, finally a large full jar as child adds one more tiny coin with proud smile. A windowsill plant grows from sprout to leafy plant across scenes to indicate time, not three different simultaneous jars. Emphasize many small savings accumulating into substantial total, no winning lottery or large single donation. Modern cozy bedroom desk, no readable coin symbols, text, dates, numbers, brands logos watermarks. Natural hands two arms five fingers, coin falls downward into wide jar opening, stable desk, perspective coherent.
